cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Lead Quantitative Modeler to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
The Lead Quantitative Modeler role will offer you the flexibility to make each day your own, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities:
Lead the development and implementation of loan performance modeling frameworks, methodologies, and algorithms to predict borrower behavior, loan defaults, prepayments, and delinquencies. Conduct in-depth analysis of economic indicators, market trends, and macroeconomic factors to inform modeling assumptions, parameter estimates, and scenario analysis. Design and implement statistical models and time series forecasting techniques to analyze historical loan performance data, identify patterns, and forecast future trends. Apply advanced machine learning algorithms, including reinforcement learning techniques, to optimize risk management strategies, automate decision-making processes, and improve model performance. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, economists, risk managers, and business stakeholders, to gather requirements, define project scope, and drive model development efforts. Develop and maintain documentation, code repositories, and model validation reports in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. Stay current with emerging trends, methodologies, and best practices in quantitative finance, econometrics, statistics, and machine learning, and apply them to enhance modeling capabilities.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
4 Years of proven experience in developing and implementing predictive models
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
Experience with time series analysis techniques and advanced machine learning algorithms in a quantitative finance or risk management environment
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn)
Strong understanding of econometric principles, statistical methodologies, and quantitative modeling techniques, with a focus on time series analysis, stochastic processes, and Bayesian inference
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
Experience with loan performance modeling, credit risk assessment, and portfolio optimization in the financial services industry
Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines

cond_0139.intro: You will be responsible for leveraging expertise in economics, statistics (with a focus on time-series modeling), and advanced machine learning techniques (including reinforcement learning) to develop predictive models, optimize risk management strategies, and drive actionable insights. You will also act as team lead while conducting theoretical and empirical research with public and proprietary data in all areas of the mortgage finance business. This may include mortgage products and securities, borrower behavior, investment and hedging strategies, residential property valuation, macroeconomic models, including housing prices and interest rate, financial valuation of finance assets and derivatives, economic capital, and stress testing. Additionally, you will coach and mentor team members. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of quantitative modeling and how it applies to mortgage finance.
cond_0139.responsibilities:

Develop and maintain documentation, code repositories, and model validation reports in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, or R, and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn). Strong understanding of econometric principles, statistical methodologies, and quantitative modeling techniques, with a focus on time series analysis, stochastic processes, and Bayesian inference. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders. This may include mortgage products and securities, borrower behavior, investment and hedging strategies, residential property valuation, macroeconomic models, including housing prices and interest rate, financial valuation of finance assets and derivatives, economic capital, and stress testing. Additionally, you will coach and mentor team members. Most people become stronger in this kind of quantitative modeling work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0149.responsibilities:
The Lead Quantitative Modeler role will offer you the flexibility to make each day your own, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities:
Lead the development and implementation of loan performance modeling frameworks, methodologies, and algorithms to predict borrower behavior, loan defaults, prepayments, and delinquencies. Conduct in-depth analysis of economic indicators, market trends, and macroeconomic factors to inform modeling assumptions, parameter estimates, and scenario analysis. Design and implement statistical models and time series forecasting techniques to analyze historical loan performance data, identify patterns, and forecast future trends. Apply advanced machine learning algorithms, including reinforcement learning techniques, to optimize risk management strategies, automate decision-making processes, and improve model performance. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, economists, risk managers, and business stakeholders, to gather requirements, define project scope, and drive model development efforts. Develop and maintain documentation, code repositories, and model validation reports in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. Stay current with emerging trends, methodologies, and best practices in quantitative finance, econometrics, statistics, and machine learning, and apply them to enhance modeling capabilities and stay ahead of the curve.
cond_0149.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
4 Years of proven experience in developing and implementing predictive models.
Bachelor's degree in economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience with time series analysis techniques and advanced machine learning algorithms in a quantitative finance or risk management environment.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, or R, and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
Strong understanding of econometric principles, statistical methodologies, and quantitative modeling techniques, with a focus on time series analysis, stochastic processes, and Bayesian inference.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience with loan performance modeling, credit risk assessment, and portfolio optimization in the financial services industry.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

cond_0222.intro: As a valued colleague on our team, you will be responsible for leveraging expertise in economics, statistics (with a focus on time-series modeling), and advanced machine learning techniques (including reinforcement learning) to develop predictive models, optimize risk management strategies, and regularly connect with stakeholders to turn analysis into actionable insights. You will also act as team lead while conducting theoretical and empirical research with public and proprietary data in all areas of the mortgage finance business. This may include mortgage products and securities, borrower behavior, investment and hedging strategies, residential property valuation, macroeconomic models, including housing prices and interest rate, financial valuation of finance assets and derivatives, economic capital, and stress testing. Additionally, you will coach and mentor team members.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
The Lead Quantitative Modeler role will offer you the flexibility to make each day your own, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities:
Lead the development and implementation of loan performance modeling frameworks, methodologies, and algorithms to predict borrower behavior, loan defaults, prepayments, and delinquencies.
Conduct in-depth analysis of economic indicators, market trends, and macroeconomic factors to inform modeling assumptions, parameter estimates, and scenario analysis, and regularly communicate findings to the broader team.
Design and implement statistical models and time series forecasting techniques to analyze historical loan performance data, identify patterns, and forecast future trends.
Apply advanced machine learning algorithms, including reinforcement learning techniques, to optimize risk management strategies, automate decision-making processes, and improve model performance.
Collaborate closely and on an ongoing basis with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, economists, risk managers, and business stakeholders, to gather requirements, clarify project scope, and actively contribute to model development efforts.
Develop and maintain documentation, code repositories, and model validation reports in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
Stay current with emerging trends, methodologies, and best practices in quantitative finance, econometrics, statistics, and machine learning, and speak up to share new approaches that can enhance modeling capabilities.
cond_0222.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
4 Years of proven experience in developing and implementing predictive models.
Bachelor's degree in economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience with time series analysis techniques and advanced machine learning algorithms in a quantitative finance or risk management environment.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
Strong understanding of econometric principles, statistical methodologies, and quantitative modeling techniques, with a focus on time series analysis, stochastic processes, and Bayesian inference.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience with loan performance modeling, credit risk assessment, and portfolio optimization in the financial services industry.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to walk non-technical stakeholders through complex technical concepts and handle their questions clearly.
Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

This may include mortgage products and securities, borrower behavior, investment and hedging strategies, residential property valuation, macroeconomic models, including housing prices and interest rate, financial valuation of finance assets and derivatives, economic capital, and stress testing. Additionally, you will coach and mentor team members.
cond_0231.responsibilities:
The Lead Quantitative Modeler role will offer you the flexibility to make each day your own, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities:
Lead the development and implementation of loan performance modeling frameworks, methodologies, and algorithms to predict borrower behavior, loan defaults, prepayments, and delinquencies. Conduct in-depth analysis of economic indicators, market trends, and macroeconomic factors to inform modeling assumptions, parameter estimates, and scenario analysis, and regularly communicate findings to the team. Design and implement statistical models and time series forecasting techniques to analyze historical loan performance data, identify patterns, and forecast future trends. Apply advanced machine learning algorithms, including reinforcement learning techniques, to optimize risk management strategies, automate decision-making processes, and improve model performance. Actively collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, economists, risk managers, and business stakeholders, on a daily basis to gather requirements, clarify project scope, and drive model development efforts — initiating discussions to resolve open questions and keep work moving. Develop and maintain documentation, code repositories, and model validation reports in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. Stay current with emerging trends, methodologies, and best practices in quantitative finance, econometrics, statistics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas back to the team to enhance modeling capabilities.
cond_0231.requirements: 4 Years of proven experience in developing and implementing predictive models. Bachelor's degree in economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. Experience with time series analysis techniques and advanced machine learning algorithms in a quantitative finance or risk management environment. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, or R, and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn). Strong understanding of econometric principles, statistical methodologies, and quantitative modeling techniques, with a focus on time series analysis, stochastic processes, and Bayesian inference. Experience with loan performance modeling, credit risk assessment, and portfolio optimization in the financial services industry is highly desirable. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and walk them through trade-offs and decisions. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

cond_0380.intro: As a valued colleague on our team, you will be responsible for leveraging expertise in economics, statistics (with a focus on time-series modeling), and advanced machine learning techniques (including reinforcement learning) to develop predictive models, optimize risk management strategies, and drive actionable insights. You will also act as team lead while conducting theoretical and empirical research with public and proprietary data in all areas of the mortgage finance business. This may include mortgage products and securities, borrower behavior, investment and hedging strategies, residential property valuation, macroeconomic models, including housing prices and interest rate, financial valuation of finance assets and derivatives, economic capital, and stress testing. Additionally, you will coach and mentor team members.
cond_0380.responsibilities:
The Lead Quantitative Modeler role will offer you the flexibility to make each day your own, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities:
Lead the development and implementation of loan performance modeling frameworks, methodologies, and algorithms to predict borrower behavior, loan defaults, prepayments, and delinquencies. Conduct in-depth analysis of economic indicators, market trends, and macroeconomic factors to inform modeling assumptions, parameter estimates, and scenario analysis. Design and implement statistical models and time series forecasting techniques to analyze historical loan performance data, identify patterns, and forecast future trends. Apply advanced machine learning algorithms, including reinforcement learning techniques, to optimize risk management strategies, automate decision-making processes, and improve model performance. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, economists, risk managers, and business stakeholders, to gather requirements, define project scope, and drive model development efforts. Develop and maintain documentation, code repositories, and model validation reports in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. Stay current with emerging trends, methodologies, and best practices in quantitative finance, econometrics, statistics, and machine learning, and apply them to enhance modeling capabilities and stay ahead of the curve.
cond_0380.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 4 years of demonstrated expertise in developing and implementing predictive models.
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Deep knowledge of time series analysis techniques and advanced machine learning algorithms in a quantitative finance or risk management environment.
Strong command of programming languages such as Python or R, with expertise in relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
Advanced knowledge of econometric principles, statistical methodologies, and quantitative modeling techniques, with a focus on time series analysis, stochastic processes, and Bayesian inference.
Preferred Requirements
Substantial experience with loan performance modeling, credit risk assessment, and portfolio optimization in the financial services industry.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

You will also act as team lead while conducting theoretical and empirical research with public and proprietary data in all areas of the mortgage finance business. This may include mortgage products and securities, borrower behavior, investment and hedging strategies, residential property valuation, macroeconomic models, including housing prices and interest rate, financial valuation of finance assets and derivatives, economic capital, and stress testing. Additionally, you will coach and mentor team members.
cond_0411.responsibilities:
The Lead Quantitative Modeler role will offer you the flexibility to make each day your own, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities:
Lead the development and implementation of loan performance modeling frameworks, methodologies, and algorithms to predict borrower behavior, loan defaults, prepayments, and delinquencies. Conduct in-depth analysis of economic indicators, market trends, and macroeconomic factors to inform modeling assumptions, parameter estimates, and scenario analysis, and regularly communicate findings to the team. Design and implement statistical models and time series forecasting techniques to analyze historical loan performance data, identify patterns, and forecast future trends. Apply advanced machine learning algorithms, including reinforcement learning techniques, to optimize risk management strategies, automate decision-making processes, and improve model performance. Actively collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, economists, risk managers, and business stakeholders, on a daily basis to gather requirements, clarify project scope, and drive model development efforts — initiating discussions to resolve open questions and keep work moving. Develop and maintain documentation, code repositories, and model validation reports in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. Stay current with emerging trends, methodologies, and best practices in quantitative finance, econometrics, statistics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas back to the team to enhance modeling capabilities.
cond_0411.requirements: 4 Years of proven experience in developing and implementing predictive models. Bachelor's degree in economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. Experience with time series analysis techniques and advanced machine learning algorithms in a quantitative finance or risk management environment. Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, or R, and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn). Strong understanding of econometric principles, statistical methodologies, and quantitative modeling techniques, with a focus on time series analysis, stochastic processes, and Bayesian inference. Experience with loan performance modeling, credit risk assessment, and portfolio optimization in the financial services industry is highly desirable. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and walk them through trade-offs and decisions. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

You will also act as team lead while conducting theoretical and empirical research with public and proprietary data in all areas of the mortgage finance business. This may include mortgage products and securities, borrower behavior, investment and hedging strategies, residential property valuation, macroeconomic models, including housing prices and interest rate, financial valuation of finance assets and derivatives, economic capital, and stress testing. Additionally, you will coach and mentor team members.
cond_0444.responsibilities:
The Lead Quantitative Modeler role will offer you the flexibility to make each day your own, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities:
Lead the development and implementation of loan performance modeling frameworks, methodologies, and algorithms to predict borrower behavior, loan defaults, prepayments, and delinquencies. Conduct in-depth analysis of economic indicators, market trends, and macroeconomic factors to inform modeling assumptions, parameter estimates, and scenario analysis. Design and implement statistical models and time series forecasting techniques to analyze historical loan performance data, identify patterns, and forecast future trends. Apply advanced machine learning algorithms, including reinforcement learning techniques, to optimize risk management strategies, automate decision-making processes, and improve model performance. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, economists, risk managers, and business stakeholders, to gather requirements, define project scope, and drive model development efforts. Develop and maintain documentation, code repositories, and model validation reports in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. Stay current with emerging trends, methodologies, and best practices in quantitative finance, econometrics, statistics, and machine learning, and apply them to enhance modeling capabilities and stay ahead of the curve.
cond_0444.requirements:
Around 4 years of experience developing and implementing predictive models, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field is a plus.
Some background in time series analysis techniques and machine learning algorithms in a quantitative finance or risk management context.
Working knowledge of programming languages such as Python or R, and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
Exposure to econometric principles, statistical methodologies, and quantitative modeling techniques, including time series analysis, stochastic processes, and Bayesian inference — candidates who have built these skills through coursework or project work are welcome to apply.
Experience with loan performance modeling, credit risk assessment, and portfolio optimization in the financial services industry is helpful but not required.
Ability to communicate effectively, including translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders, and openness to working collaboratively across teams and managing multiple projects.

Lead the development and implementation of loan performance modeling frameworks, methodologies, and algorithms to predict borrower behavior, loan defaults, prepayments, and delinquencies.
Conduct in-depth analysis of economic indicators, market trends, and macroeconomic factors to inform modeling assumptions, parameter estimates, and scenario analysis, and regularly communicate findings to the broader team.
Design and implement statistical models and time series forecasting techniques to analyze historical loan performance data, identify patterns, and forecast future trends.
Apply advanced machine learning algorithms, including reinforcement learning techniques, to optimize risk management strategies, automate decision-making processes, and improve model performance.
Collaborate closely and on an ongoing basis with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, economists, risk managers, and business stakeholders, to gather requirements, clarify project scope, and actively contribute to model development efforts.
Develop and maintain documentation, code repositories, and model validation reports in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.
Stay current with emerging trends, methodologies, and best practices in quantitative finance, econometrics, statistics, and machine learning, and speak up to share new approaches that can enhance modeling capabilities.
cond_0474.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
4 Years of proven experience in developing and implementing predictive models.
Bachelor's degree in economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience with time series analysis techniques and advanced machine learning algorithms in a quantitative finance or risk management environment.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
Strong understanding of econometric principles, statistical methodologies, and quantitative modeling techniques, with a focus on time series analysis, stochastic processes, and Bayesian inference.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced degree in Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience with loan performance modeling, credit risk assessment, and portfolio optimization in the financial services industry.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to walk non-technical stakeholders through complex technical concepts and handle their questions clearly.
Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.
